Title: Pan-Genome-Scale Metabolic Reconstruction Reveals Conserved Metabolic Functions in Candida albicans
Summary: Constructs a Candida albicans pan-genome-scale metabolic model and 80 strain-specific GEMs from public assemblies to map conserved metabolic functions across the species.

Title: ML4SD: Leveraging Machine Learning and High-Throughput Search Algorithms for an Iterative Growth-Coupled Design Innovation
Summary: Presents ML4SD, an active-learning DBTL cycle that trains ensembles on genome-scale metabolic model scores of knockout designs for growth-coupled production in Pseudomonas putida.

Title: A simplified modelling protocol for synthetic biology
Summary: Introduces BOOLSYN, a boolean molecular-network protocol for early-stage qualitative modelling of synthetic biology designs without specialized numerical software.

Title: System-level reconstruction of RpoD, RpoS, and RpoN regulatory networks in Pseudomonas putida KT2440
Summary: Reconstructs RpoD, RpoS, and RpoN regulons in Pseudomonas putida KT2440 by integrating ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, and independent component analysis.

Title: Metabolic engineering of Escherichia coli for efficient production of l-homoserine from sugarcane molasses
Summary: Engineers a plasmid-free Escherichia coli strain to produce L-homoserine from sugarcane molasses by adding sucrose assimilation, efflux transporters, and anaplerotic flux changes.

Title: A novel route for valerolactam production in Corynebacterium glutamicum: metabolic engineering and bioprocess optimization
Summary: Engineers Corynebacterium glutamicum for valerolactam production via davBA, lysP, and avaC, then improves titer with carbon-limited fed-batch cultivation.

Title: Regulation–Metabolism Rewiring Enables Efficient Nicotinamide Mononucleotide Biosynthesis in Food-Grade Lactiplantibacillus plantarum
Summary: Rewires NMN regulation and pentose-phosphate flux in food-grade Lactiplantibacillus plantarum after identifying the GntR-family transcription factor lp_0262 as a key NMN-metabolism regulator.

Title: A methylome-guided toolkit for genetic engineering of the fast-growing cyanobacterium UTEX 3222
Summary: Enables genetic transformation of Cyanobacterium aponinum UTEX 3222 with methylation-guided methods, a shuttle vector, and a promoter screen for high-density photosynthetic chassis engineering.

Title: Regulation of Surfactin Biosynthesis Pathways in Bacillus sp.: Regulatory Network Reconstruction and Metabolic Engineering Perspectives
Summary: Reviews Bacillus subtilis pathways that control surfactin biosynthesis and reconstructs a global regulatory network to guide metabolic engineering of surfactin production.

Title: Advances in microbial cell factories for substitute sugar xylitol production: from metabolic engineering to AI-driven bioprocessing
Summary: Reviews metabolic engineering of microbial xylitol cell factories, including pathway reconstruction, cofactor engineering, and AI-guided metabolic-network prediction in a DBTL loop.

Title: Advances in Plant Metabolic Engineering Through Synthetic Biology
Summary: Reviews synthetic-biology technologies for plant metabolic engineering, including AI-assisted design and optimization of metabolic pathways for crop nutrition, yield, and stress resilience.
